pricing_policy.reason: Phase 1 material batches refresh exact recipe floors without silently repricing finished professions. Blacksmithing and other explicitly reviewed scopes use saved Evidence Pricing market-value overrides; all unreviewed profession outputs remain preserved.

glyph.materials: Ink plus parchment; use the matching ink tier or Ink of the Sea exchange path
glyph.notes: Curated level-80 build glyph. Post singles first; duplicates are for restocking, not bulk dumping.

stat-scroll.materials: 1 Ink of the Sea + 2 Resilient Parchment produces 2 scrolls
stat-scroll.notes: Also appears as loot, but Inscription can manufacture the same tradeable item. Do not confuse it with drop-only Protection scrolls.

runescroll.materials: 1 Snowfall Ink + 5 Resilient Parchment produces 5 scrolls
runescroll.notes: Raid-buff substitute when a Priest is unavailable. Check whether the server's buff stacking matches normal 3.3.5 behavior.

armor-vellum.materials: 1 Ink of the Sea + 2 Resilient Parchment produces 2 vellums
armor-vellum.notes: Rank III stores WotLK armor enchants for AH sale. Sell useful small stacks.

weapon-vellum.materials: 3 Ink of the Sea + 2 Resilient Parchment produces 2 vellums
weapon-vellum.notes: Rank III stores WotLK weapon enchants for AH sale. Usually slower than Armor Vellum III.

certificate.notes: Hunter pet-renaming utility. Niche, but genuinely tradeable and useful.

boe-offhand.materials: High-level inks, parchment, and supporting reagents
boe-offhand.notes: BoE level-77 caster off-hand. Treat as a slow gearing item and craft one at a time.

nobles-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
nobles-card.notes: Greatness-set card. Exact-card scarcity matters more than average card cost.

chaos-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
chaos-card.notes: Berserker-set card. Singles mainly sell to players finishing a deck.

prisms-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
prisms-card.notes: Illusion-set card. Singles mainly sell to players finishing a deck.

undeath-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
undeath-card.notes: Death-set card. Demand is better than the other non-Nobles sets but still completion-driven.

nobles-deck.notes: Tradeable deck used for the Greatness trinket quest. The rewarded trinket is not an AH item.

other-deck.materials: Ace through Eight of the matching set
other-deck.notes: Tradeable completed deck. Do not price it from Nobles/Greatness demand.

engineering-part.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the recipe's Engineering reagents; add only a convenience margin

engineering-explosive.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the recipe's metals, powders, and triggers; price per finished unit

engineering-ammo.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the recipe's metal and Engineering components; use the listed stack guidance

engineering-powder.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching stones or motes; add a small convenience margin

alchemy-flask.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching herbs, Frost Lotus, and Enchanted Vial; price per finished flask

alchemy-potion.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching herbs, oils, and Crystal Vial; price per finished potion

alchemy-oil.materials: Saved non-circular cost of Pygmy Suckerfish; account for the recipe's variable oil yield

alchemy-transmute.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the required Primals; add only a convenience margin because cooldown scarcity may not apply

alchemy-wrath-flask.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Northrend herbs and vial; price per finished flask
alchemy-wrath-flask.notes: Fallback market band for a less-common Wrath flask. Check competition and actual demand before making a batch without changing the saved baseline.

alchemy-wrath-elixir.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Northrend herbs, oils, and vial; price per finished elixir
alchemy-wrath-elixir.notes: Fallback Wrath elixir band. Demand varies sharply by role and raid schedule; test small stacks first.

alchemy-wrath-potion.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Northrend herbs, oils, and vial; price per finished potion
alchemy-wrath-potion.notes: Fallback Wrath utility-potion band. Use observed sell-through only to decide whether and how much to post; it does not rewrite the saved baseline.

alchemy-wrath-protection.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Crystallized element and vial; price per finished protection potion
alchemy-wrath-protection.notes: Encounter-specific Wrath protection potion. Confirm that Hellscream mechanics create real demand before stocking deeply.

alchemy-wrath-intermediate.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the recipe input; account for any variable output quantity
alchemy-wrath-intermediate.notes: Wrath Alchemy intermediate. Compare the finished item directly with its input before converting.

alchemy-wrath-transmute.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the exact transmute inputs; use the output quantity shown by the server
alchemy-wrath-transmute.notes: Fallback transmute band only. Gem and metal values move independently, and cooldown scarcity may differ on Hellscream.

alchemy-outland-flask.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Outland herbs, Fel Lotus, and vial; price per finished flask
alchemy-outland-flask.notes: Legacy raid flask with a narrow market. Post singles and verify level-70 or collector demand before restocking.

alchemy-outland-elixir.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Outland herbs and vial; price per finished elixir
alchemy-outland-elixir.notes: Legacy elixir and leveling craft. Small stacks reduce risk in the thin level-60 to 70 market.

alchemy-outland-potion.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Outland herbs and vial; price per finished potion
alchemy-outland-potion.notes: Legacy potion and leveling craft. Treat the listed prices as provisional saved bands until qualifying realized-sale or measured-yield evidence replaces them.

alchemy-outland-protection.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Primal or mote reagents and vial; price per finished potion
alchemy-outland-protection.notes: Legacy encounter-specific protection potion. Verify the relevant damage mechanic and buyer pool before crafting.

alchemy-outland-cauldron.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching protection potions and cauldron reagents; price per finished cauldron
alchemy-outland-cauldron.notes: Very niche group utility. Confirm that the cauldron remains tradeable and useful under Hellscream's server rules before crafting.

alchemy-outland-intermediate.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the exact Outland recipe inputs; price per finished intermediate
alchemy-outland-intermediate.notes: Legacy Alchemy intermediate. Compare directly with its inputs and downstream craft demand.

alchemy-outland-transmute.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the exact Outland transmute inputs; account for specialization procs
alchemy-outland-transmute.notes: Legacy transmute output. Cooldown and proc behavior can differ on Hellscream, so verify both before pricing.

alchemy-classic-flask.materials: Saved non-circular cost of Black Lotus, matching Classic herbs, and vial; price per finished flask
alchemy-classic-flask.notes: Classic raid flask with expensive inputs and thin demand. Post singles and avoid speculative batches.

alchemy-classic-leveling-elixir.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Classic herbs and vial; price per finished elixir
alchemy-classic-leveling-elixir.notes: Leveling elixir or skill-up output. Sell inexpensive small stacks only where actual leveling demand exists.

alchemy-classic-endgame-elixir.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching high-tier Classic herbs and vial; price per finished elixir
alchemy-classic-endgame-elixir.notes: Classic endgame or specialty elixir. Recipe rarity can justify a premium only when buyers are present.

alchemy-classic-leveling-potion.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Classic herbs and vial; price per finished potion
alchemy-classic-leveling-potion.notes: Leveling potion or skill-up output. Vendor competition and low demand make small stacks safest.

alchemy-classic-endgame-potion.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching high-tier Classic herbs and vial; price per finished potion
alchemy-classic-endgame-potion.notes: Classic endgame or specialty potion. Test singles or small stacks before committing rare herbs.

alchemy-classic-leveling-protection.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching Classic elemental reagent, herbs, and vial
alchemy-classic-leveling-protection.notes: Low-tier protection potion. Demand is encounter-specific and usually thin on a level-80 server.

alchemy-classic-endgame-protection.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the matching high-tier Classic elemental reagent, herbs, and vial
alchemy-classic-endgame-protection.notes: Classic endgame protection potion. Verify raid, dungeon, or PvP demand before crafting a batch.

alchemy-classic-intermediate.materials: Saved non-circular cost of the exact Classic recipe inputs; account for output quantity
alchemy-classic-intermediate.notes: Classic Alchemy oil, dye, fuel, or specialty intermediate. Compare directly with downstream demand.

enchanting-wrath-weapon.materials: Exact Northrend dust, essence, shard, crystal, and Weapon Vellum III cost for this enchant
enchanting-wrath-weapon.notes: Wrath weapon-enchant scroll. Prices vary sharply by recipe; treat this as a fallback band and never list below the exact reagent and vellum floor.

enchanting-wrath-armor.materials: Exact Northrend dust, essence, shard, crystal, and Armor Vellum III cost for this enchant
enchanting-wrath-armor.notes: Wrath armor-enchant scroll. Post singles first and price from the exact recipe because premium and leveling enchants do not share one true market value.

enchanting-outland-weapon.materials: Exact Outland dust, essence, shard, crystal, and compatible Weapon Vellum cost for this enchant
enchanting-outland-weapon.notes: Legacy weapon-enchant scroll. Recipe rarity matters only when a level-70, twink, or appearance-driven buyer is actually present.

enchanting-outland-armor.materials: Exact Outland dust, essence, shard, crystal, and compatible Armor Vellum cost for this enchant
enchanting-outland-armor.notes: Legacy armor-enchant scroll. Test one listing at a time; scarcity does not guarantee sell-through on a level-80 realm.

enchanting-classic-weapon.materials: Exact Classic dust, essence, shard, and compatible Weapon Vellum cost for this enchant
enchanting-classic-weapon.notes: Classic weapon-enchant scroll for leveling, twinks, or legacy use. Rare formulas can justify a premium only after real buyer demand appears.

enchanting-classic-armor.materials: Exact Classic dust, essence, shard, and compatible Armor Vellum cost for this enchant
enchanting-classic-armor.notes: Classic armor-enchant scroll. Use singles and small fallback prices; many low-rank enchants are leveling conveniences rather than steady sellers.

enchanting-classic-oil.materials: Exact Classic dust, shard, herb, and vial cost for the finished oil
enchanting-classic-oil.notes: Legacy weapon oil. Confirm that the effect works under Hellscream's server rules and post one at a time.

enchanting-outland-oil.materials: Exact Arcane Dust, Nightmare Vine, and Imbued Vial cost for the finished oil
enchanting-outland-oil.notes: Burning Crusade weapon oil. This is a narrow legacy-consumable market; test one listing before restocking.

enchanting-classic-wand.materials: Exact wood and matching lesser or greater essence cost for the finished wand
enchanting-classic-wand.notes: BoE caster leveling wand. Craft one at a time because demand depends on fresh characters and the current weapon supply.

enchanting-intermediate.materials: Exact source material and Dream Dust cost for the finished Enchanting intermediate
enchanting-intermediate.notes: Tradeable Enchanting intermediate. Compare the finished item directly with its raw input and downstream recipe demand.

enchanting-prismatic-gem.materials: Exact Large Prismatic Shard cost for the finished Outland prismatic gem
enchanting-prismatic-gem.notes: Legacy all-resistance gem. Post singles and verify socket demand before converting valuable shards.

blacksmithing-craft.materials: Exact WotLK 3.3.5 recipe cost per minimum guaranteed output
blacksmithing-craft.notes: Tradeable Blacksmithing output; compare the current finished market with the exact craft cost before posting.

jc-output.notes: See the item-specific note and shared craft-cost policy.

faces-doom.row_note: BoE level-77 caster off-hand with 42 Intellect, 42 Spirit, 49 spell power, and 42 critical strike rating.

glyph-disease.name: Glyph of Disease
glyph-disease.row_note: Death Knight only: Your Pestilence ability now refreshes disease durations and secondary effects of diseases on your primary target back to their maximum duration.

glyph-dark-death.name: Glyph of Dark Death
glyph-dark-death.row_note: Death Knight only: Increases the damage or healing done by Death Coil by 15%.

glyph-death-strike.name: Glyph of Death Strike
glyph-death-strike.row_note: Death Knight only: Increases your Death Strike's damage by 1% for every 1 runic power you currently have (up to a maximum of 25%). The runic power is not consumed by this effect.

glyph-icy-touch.name: Glyph of Icy Touch
glyph-icy-touch.row_note: Death Knight only: Your Frost Fever disease deals 20% additional damage.

glyph-rune-strike.name: Glyph of Rune Strike
glyph-rune-strike.row_note: Death Knight only: Increases the critical strike chance of your Rune Strike by 10%.

glyph-vampiric-blood.name: Glyph of Vampiric Blood
glyph-vampiric-blood.row_note: Death Knight only: Increases the duration of your Vampiric Blood by 5 sec.

glyph-starfire.name: Glyph of Starfire
glyph-starfire.row_note: Druid only: Your Starfire ability increases the duration of your Moonfire effect on the target by 3 sec, up to a maximum of 9 additional seconds.

glyph-insect-swarm.name: Glyph of Insect Swarm
glyph-insect-swarm.row_note: Druid only: Increases the damage of your Insect Swarm ability by 30%, but it no longer affects your victim's chance to hit.

glyph-rapid-rejuvenation.name: Glyph of Rapid Rejuvenation
glyph-rapid-rejuvenation.row_note: Druid only: Your haste now reduces the time between the periodic healing ticks of your Rejuvenation spell.

glyph-wild-growth.name: Glyph of Wild Growth
glyph-wild-growth.row_note: Druid only: Wild Growth can affect 1 additional target.

glyph-savage-roar.name: Glyph of Savage Roar
glyph-savage-roar.row_note: Druid only: Your Savage Roar ability grants an additional 3% bonus damage done.

glyph-maul.name: Glyph of Maul
glyph-maul.row_note: Druid only: Your Maul ability now hits 1 additional target.

glyph-explosive-shot.name: Glyph of Explosive Shot
glyph-explosive-shot.row_note: Hunter only: Increases the critical strike chance of Explosive Shot by 4%.

glyph-kill-shot.name: Glyph of Kill Shot
glyph-kill-shot.row_note: Hunter only: Reduces the cooldown of Kill Shot by 6 sec.

glyph-serpent-sting.name: Glyph of Serpent Sting
glyph-serpent-sting.row_note: Hunter only: Increases the duration of your Serpent Sting by 6 sec.

glyph-steady-shot.name: Glyph of Steady Shot
glyph-steady-shot.row_note: Hunter only: Increases the damage dealt by Steady Shot by 10% when your target is afflicted with Serpent Sting.

glyph-chimera-shot.name: Glyph of Chimera Shot
glyph-chimera-shot.row_note: Hunter only: Reduces the cooldown of Chimera Shot by 1 sec.

glyph-bestial-wrath.name: Glyph of Bestial Wrath
glyph-bestial-wrath.row_note: Hunter only: Decreases the cooldown of Bestial Wrath by 20 sec.

glyph-arcane-blast.name: Glyph of Arcane Blast
glyph-arcane-blast.row_note: Mage only: Increases the damage from your Arcane Blast buff by 3%.

glyph-arcane-missiles.name: Glyph of Arcane Missiles
glyph-arcane-missiles.row_note: Mage only: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of Arcane Missiles by 25%.

glyph-fireball.name: Glyph of Fireball
glyph-fireball.row_note: Mage only: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball spell by 0.15 sec, but removes the damage over time effect.

glyph-living-bomb.name: Glyph of Living Bomb
glyph-living-bomb.row_note: Mage only: The periodic damage from your Living Bomb can now be critical strikes.

glyph-molten-armor.name: Glyph of Molten Armor
glyph-molten-armor.row_note: Mage only: Your Molten Armor grants an additional 20% of your spirit as critical strike rating.

glyph-frostfire.name: Glyph of Frostfire
glyph-frostfire.row_note: Mage only: Increases the initial damage dealt by Frostfire Bolt by 2% and its critical strike chance by 2%.

glyph-seal-vengeance.name: Glyph of Seal of Vengeance
glyph-seal-vengeance.row_note: Paladin only: Your Seal of Vengeance or Seal of Corruption also grants 10 expertise while active.

glyph-divine-plea.name: Glyph of Divine Plea
glyph-divine-plea.row_note: Paladin only: While Divine Plea is active, you take 3% reduced damage from all sources.

glyph-righteous-defense.name: Glyph of Righteous Defense
glyph-righteous-defense.row_note: Paladin only: Increases the chance for your Righteous Defense and Hand of Reckoning abilities to work successfully by 8% on each target.

glyph-hammer-righteous.name: Glyph of Hammer of the Righteous
glyph-hammer-righteous.row_note: Paladin only: Your Hammer of the Righteous hits 1 additional target.

glyph-holy-light.name: Glyph of Holy Light
glyph-holy-light.row_note: Paladin only: Your Holy Light grants 10% of its heal amount to up to 5 friendly targets within 8 yards of the initial target.

glyph-beacon-light.name: Glyph of Beacon of Light
glyph-beacon-light.row_note: Paladin only: Increases the duration of Beacon of Light by 30 sec.

glyph-mind-flay.name: Glyph of Mind Flay
glyph-mind-flay.row_note: Priest only: Increases the damage done by your Mind Flay spell by 10% when your target is afflicted with Shadow Word: Pain.

glyph-dispersion.name: Glyph of Dispersion
glyph-dispersion.row_note: Priest only: Reduces the cooldown on Dispersion by 45 sec.

glyph-penance.name: Glyph of Penance
glyph-penance.row_note: Priest only: Reduces the cooldown of Penance by 2 sec.

glyph-power-word-shield.name: Glyph of Power Word: Shield
glyph-power-word-shield.row_note: Priest only: Your Power Word: Shield also heals the target for 20% of the absorption amount.

glyph-guardian-spirit.name: Glyph of Guardian Spirit
glyph-guardian-spirit.row_note: Priest only: If your Guardian Spirit lasts its entire duration without being triggered, the cooldown is reset to 1 min.

glyph-circle-healing.name: Glyph of Circle of Healing
glyph-circle-healing.row_note: Priest only: Your Circle of Healing spell heals 1 additional target.

glyph-mutilate.name: Glyph of Mutilate

glyph-hunger-blood.name: Glyph of Hunger for Blood
glyph-hunger-blood.row_note: Rogue only: Increases the bonus damage from Hunger For Blood by 3%.

glyph-tricks-trade.name: Glyph of Tricks of the Trade
glyph-tricks-trade.row_note: Rogue only: The bonus damage and threat redirection granted by your Tricks of the Trade ability lasts an additional 4 sec.

glyph-sinister-strike.name: Glyph of Sinister Strike
glyph-sinister-strike.row_note: Rogue only: Your Sinister Strike critical strikes have a 50% chance to add an additional combo point.

glyph-killing-spree.name: Glyph of Killing Spree
glyph-killing-spree.row_note: Rogue only: Reduces the cooldown on Killing Spree by 45 sec.

glyph-eviscerate.name: Glyph of Eviscerate
glyph-eviscerate.row_note: Rogue only: Increases the critical strike chance of Eviscerate by 10%.

glyph-lightning-bolt.name: Glyph of Lightning Bolt
glyph-lightning-bolt.row_note: Shaman only: Increases the damage dealt by Lightning Bolt by 4%.

glyph-flame-shock.name: Glyph of Flame Shock
glyph-flame-shock.row_note: Shaman only: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Flame Shock damage by 60%.

glyph-lava.name: Glyph of Lava
glyph-lava.row_note: Shaman only: Your Lava Burst spell gains an additional 10% of your spellpower.

glyph-totem-wrath.name: Glyph of Totem of Wrath
glyph-totem-wrath.row_note: Shaman only: When you cast Totem of Wrath, you gain 30% of the totem's bonus spell power for 5 min.

glyph-chain-heal.name: Glyph of Chain Heal
glyph-chain-heal.row_note: Shaman only: Your Chain Heal heals 1 additional target.

glyph-earth-shield.name: Glyph of Earth Shield
glyph-earth-shield.row_note: Shaman only: Increases the amount healed by your Earth Shield by 20%.

glyph-quick-decay.name: Glyph of Quick Decay
glyph-quick-decay.row_note: Warlock only: Your haste now reduces the time between periodic damage ticks of your Corruption spell.

glyph-life-tap.name: Glyph of Life Tap
glyph-life-tap.row_note: Warlock only: When you use Life Tap or Dark Pact, you gain 20% of your Spirit as spell power for 40 sec.

glyph-haunt.name: Glyph of Haunt
glyph-haunt.row_note: Warlock only: The bonus damage granted by your Haunt spell is increased by an additional 3%.

glyph-conflagrate.name: Glyph of Conflagrate
glyph-conflagrate.row_note: Warlock only: Your Conflagrate spell no longer consumes your Immolate or Shadowflame spell from the target.

glyph-incinerate.name: Glyph of Incinerate
glyph-incinerate.row_note: Warlock only: Increases the damage done by Incinerate by 5%.

glyph-felguard.name: Glyph of Felguard
glyph-felguard.row_note: Warlock only: Increases the Felguard's total attack power by 20%.

glyph-devastate.name: Glyph of Devastate
glyph-devastate.row_note: Warrior only: Your Devastate ability now applies two stacks of Sunder Armor.

glyph-blocking.row_note: Warrior only: Increases your block value by 10% for 10 sec after using your Shield Slam ability.

glyph-vigilance.name: Glyph of Vigilance

glyph-shield-wall.row_note: Warrior only: Reduces the cooldown on Shield Wall by 2 min, but Shield Wall now only reduces damage taken by 40%.

mining-titansteel-bar.name: Titansteel Bar
mining-titansteel-bar.row_note: 3 Titanium Bars + 1 Eternal Fire + 1 Eternal Earth + 1 Eternal Shadow → 1 bar. Major Blacksmithing and Engineering input. Standard 3.3.5 data shows no cooldown; do not add cooldown scarcity unless Hellscream displays one.

mining-saronite-bar.name: Saronite Bar
mining-saronite-bar.row_note: 2 Saronite Ore → 1 bar. Core Wrath Blacksmithing and Engineering material; stacks of 5, 10, and 20 match common leveling and gear batches.

mining-cobalt-bar.name: Cobalt Bar
mining-cobalt-bar.row_note: 1 Cobalt Ore → 1 bar. Early Northrend Blacksmithing and Engineering catch-up material; the one-to-one conversion makes ore-versus-bar comparison direct.

mining-hardened-khorium.name: Hardened Khorium
mining-hardened-khorium.row_note: 3 Khorium Bars + 1 Hardened Adamantite Bar → 1. Sunwell-era Blacksmithing material with rare recipe access and slow turnover; make by commission or post one.

mining-khorium-bar.name: Khorium Bar
mining-khorium-bar.row_note: 2 Khorium Ore → 1 bar. Scarce Outland input for Blacksmithing, Engineering, and Jewelcrafting; lead with singles and pairs.

mining-felsteel-bar.name: Felsteel Bar
mining-felsteel-bar.row_note: 3 Fel Iron Bars + 2 Eternium Bars → 1. Used by legacy Blacksmithing and Engineering; price the five direct component bars before converting.

mining-hardened-adamantite-bar.name: Hardened Adamantite Bar
mining-hardened-adamantite-bar.row_note: 10 Adamantite Bars → 1. Large Blacksmithing and Engineering conversion; never list below the ten-bar opportunity cost.

mining-adamantite-bar.name: Adamantite Bar
mining-adamantite-bar.row_note: 2 Adamantite Ore → 1 bar. Broad Outland Blacksmithing, Engineering, and Jewelcrafting input; useful leveling stacks are 5, 10, and 20.

mining-eternium-bar.name: Eternium Bar
mining-eternium-bar.row_note: 2 Eternium Ore → 1 bar. Direct Felsteel component and legacy profession input; the old row was below its two-ore opportunity cost and has been corrected.

mining-fel-iron-bar.name: Fel Iron Bar
mining-fel-iron-bar.row_note: 2 Fel Iron Ore → 1 bar. Standard Outland Blacksmithing and Engineering leveling material and a Felsteel component.

mining-mote-of-fire.name: Mote of Fire
mining-mote-of-fire.row_note: Fire Sunder converts 1 Primal Fire → 10 Motes of Fire. This is the exact reverse of the normal ten-mote combine, so the row shares the canonical mote value without a convenience markup.

mining-mote-of-earth.name: Mote of Earth
mining-mote-of-earth.row_note: Earth Shatter converts 1 Primal Earth → 10 Motes of Earth. This is the exact reverse of the normal ten-mote combine, so the row shares the canonical mote value without a convenience markup.

mining-elementium-bar.name: Elementium Bar
mining-elementium-bar.row_note: 1 Elementium Ore + 10 Arcanite Bars + 1 Fiery Core + 3 Elemental Flux → 1. Thunderfury quest material with raid-gated inputs and specialized recipe access; arrange a commission before crafting ten.

mining-dark-iron-bar.name: Dark Iron Bar
mining-dark-iron-bar.row_note: 8 Dark Iron Ore → 1 bar, smelted at the Black Forge in Blackrock Depths. Legacy raid, resistance, and specialty-craft buyers pay for both ore volume and location access.

mining-thorium-bar.name: Thorium Bar
mining-thorium-bar.row_note: 1 Thorium Ore → 1 bar. Major Classic Blacksmithing and Engineering leveling input and a component of Enchanting's Enchanted Thorium Bar.

mining-truesilver-bar.name: Truesilver Bar
mining-truesilver-bar.row_note: 1 Truesilver Ore → 1 bar. Bought for Enchanting rods plus legacy Blacksmithing and Engineering; post singles and fives first.

mining-mithril-bar.name: Mithril Bar
mining-mithril-bar.row_note: 1 Mithril Ore → 1 bar. Frequent Blacksmithing and Engineering leveling bottleneck; sell useful recipe-sized stacks rather than only full stacks.

mining-steel-bar.name: Steel Bar
mining-steel-bar.row_note: 1 Iron Bar + 1 vendor Coal → 1 Steel Bar. Blacksmithing and Engineering leveling demand is steady; Coal uses exact vendor cost, not AH asks.

mining-iron-bar.name: Iron Bar
mining-iron-bar.row_note: 1 Iron Ore → 1 bar. Core Blacksmithing and Engineering leveling material and the direct input for Steel Bars.

mining-gold-bar.name: Gold Bar
mining-gold-bar.row_note: 1 Gold Ore → 1 bar. Legacy Engineering, Blacksmithing, and Jewelcrafting input; singles and fives fit most recipes.

mining-silver-bar.name: Silver Bar
mining-silver-bar.row_note: 1 Silver Ore → 1 bar. Early Enchanting rod and legacy crafting input; post singles and fives for profession catch-up.

mining-bronze-bar.name: Bronze Bar
mining-bronze-bar.row_note: 1 Copper Bar + 1 Tin Bar → 2 Bronze Bars. Price per finished bar; Blacksmithing, Engineering, and Jewelcrafting levelers commonly buy 5, 10, or 20.

mining-tin-bar.name: Tin Bar
mining-tin-bar.row_note: 1 Tin Ore → 1 bar. Low-level profession material and half of the two-bar Bronze recipe; compare direct Tin demand with Bronze demand.

mining-copper-bar.name: Copper Bar
mining-copper-bar.row_note: 1 Copper Ore → 1 bar. Broad starter material for Blacksmithing, Engineering, and Jewelcrafting and half of the two-bar Bronze recipe.

firstaid-heavy-mageweave-bandage.name: Heavy Mageweave Bandage

firstaid-runecloth-bandage.name: Runecloth Bandage

firstaid-heavy-runecloth-bandage.name: Heavy Runecloth Bandage

firstaid-netherweave-bandage.name: Netherweave Bandage
firstaid-netherweave-bandage.row_note: Heals 2,800 damage over an 8 sec channel. Outland leveling recovery and First Aid catch-up item with narrow demand.

firstaid-heavy-netherweave-bandage.name: Heavy Netherweave Bandage
firstaid-heavy-netherweave-bandage.row_note: Heals 3,400 damage over an 8 sec channel. Strong Outland recovery and a practical bridge to Northrend First Aid.

firstaid-frostweave-bandage.name: Frostweave Bandage
firstaid-frostweave-bandage.row_note: Heals 4,800 damage over an 8 sec channel. Level-80 recovery option for buyers who have not reached Heavy Frostweave rank.

firstaid-heavy-frostweave-bandage.name: Heavy Frostweave Bandage

firstaid-anti-venom.name: Anti-Venom
firstaid-anti-venom.row_note: Cures poisons up to level 25 with a 1 min cooldown. The recipe creates three; price and post per finished item for leveling or niche PvP use.

The completed Phase 2 Tailoring snapshot remains frozen at 406 outputs; Flying Carpet is the separately reviewed collectible addendum. The Tailoring review found usable relative-rank evidence for 377 finished outputs and changed 384 bands; five insufficient-coverage candidates retained their prior values. All 2,334 Tailoring comparison requests resolved. The First Aid review found usable relative-rank evidence for 17 outputs and changed 17 bands after coverage safeguards; 0 insufficient-coverage candidates retained their prior values. All 102 First Aid comparison requests resolved; no completed First Aid sales were found. External gold was not copied, and active Hellscream listings never set price. The 17 cloth intermediates retain Phase 1B material evidence. Fifteen First Aid items require the stated rank, while Anti-Venom and Strong Anti-Venom do not.

shared_note.text: The Tailoring review found usable relative-rank evidence for 377 finished outputs and changed 384 bands; five insufficient-coverage candidates retained their prior values. All 2,334 Tailoring comparison requests resolved. mining-smithing-ah-price-guide.html.intro_description: This catalog covers 24 unique tradeable outputs from the standard WotLK 3.3.5 Mining spell list: 22 Mining-owned bars and alloys with completed Phase 1A Evidence Pricing decisions plus two exact reversible 10:1 elemental breakdowns. The Phase 2 closeout revalidated every saved band, recipe, duplicate, note, and conversion without fetching a redundant second market snapshot or changing a price. Titanium Bar and Enchanted Thorium Bar remain related references because their identical items are owned by the canonical Alchemy and Enchanting catalogs; the other 16 Mining ranks, tracking, smelting headers, and Toughness passives create no tradeable output. Exact 3.3.5 recipe inputs, ratios, guaranteed output, and saved non-circular values remain separate craftability diagnostics. No active Hellscream listing value sets either layer.

shared_note.label: Evidence Pricing and smelting cost
shared_note.text: Twenty-two bars and alloys retain their completed Phase 1A Evidence Pricing decisions; all had three-realm relative-rank coverage, external gold was not copied, and active Hellscream listings never set value. Mote of Fire and Mote of Earth retain exact reversible 10:1 conversion pricing without a convenience markup. Exact 3.3.5 input ratios and guaranteed output remain separate craftability diagnostics: five market estimates fall below at least one matching floor, so do not buy those inputs to smelt at the saved sale values. Standard 3.3.5 data shows no Titansteel cooldown; verify Hellscream before charging for server-specific access.

inscription-materials-ah-price-guide.htm.intro_description: This curated catalog covers 107 tradeable Inscription outputs: 60 level-80 glyphs, six buff scrolls, two Enchanter-only blank vellums, three utility or BoE items, 32 exact Northrend Darkmoon cards, and four completed decks. Finished-output sale bands use saved Evidence Pricing reviews, while exact 3.3.5 recipes remain separate craftability diagnostics. Darkmoon Card of the North input cost is a random-roll diagnostic rather than a guaranteed exact-card floor. Prices are per finished item.

shared_note.label: Evidence Pricing and craft diagnostics
shared_note.text: The 105 glyph, scroll, utility, BoE, exact-card, and completed-deck outputs use Evidence Pricing from qualified completed sales or fixed comparable Hellscream fallbacks; external observations set relative rank only and active Hellscream asks never set price. Armor Vellum III and Weapon Vellum III retain their reviewed material evidence. Exact recipe or card opportunity cost remains a separate craftability diagnostic, so skip deterministic outputs priced below that cost unless your inputs are cheaper. Darkmoon Card of the North creates one random named card: its input cost is per roll, not a guaranteed floor for an exact card. Completed decks use all eight exact cards. Glyph discovery and Book of Glyph Mastery access are supply constraints, not hidden premiums.

shared_note.label: Evidence Pricing and craft diagnostics
shared_note.text: All 206 crafted Alchemy outputs use saved market reviews: the dedicated 84-potion snapshot, the 24 reviewed material/intermediate records, and the companion 98-output flask, elixir, cauldron, and Eternal Might review. Qualified completed sales may set value; sparse sales shrink toward fixed comparable Hellscream anchors, while external observations set relative rank only and active Hellscream asks never set price. Exact 3.3.5 recipe cost remains a separate craftability diagnostic, so skip outputs priced below that floor unless your inputs are cheaper. Specialization procs are excluded from guaranteed output. Cauldrons are valued as sealed 25-use items. Standard flasks occupy both elixir slots and persist through death.
